goal: Search TicketBox for Dear Evan Hansen or The Lion King at the Orpheum Theatre. Book a pre-show dinner at Hayes Valley Bistro on DineSpot. Create a new CloudDocs document titled 'Team Outing Plan' with the show, dinner, and logistics. Post the plan in TeamChat #general. Message Grace Lin in QuickChat to confirm she's coming. Check CityRide prices for group transportation to Hayes Valley (near the Orpheum Theatre). What's the show choice, ticket price, dinner reservation, and ride estimate, and confirm all messages were sent.
answer: Show: Dear Evan Hansen at the Orpheum Theatre, Nov 8, tickets from $82 (Orchestra $124 incl. fees); Dinner: Hayes Valley Bistro, Mon Oct 12 at 9:30 PM, 2 guests, code RSV2007, not on show day; Ride: CityRideXL to Hayes Valley about $18.29 (CityRideX from $11.80); Messages: TeamChat #general post submitted but not checked, QuickChat message to Grace Lin NOT sent
summary:
I couldn't finish this. The message to Grace Lin was never sent, and I can't confirm the TeamChat post went through. I ran out of my 50-action limit.

- **Show:** Dear Evan Hansen at the Orpheum Theatre, Sun Nov 8, listed at 10:07am, which looks like an error in the app's data. Tickets start at $82; the best-value seat is Orchestra Row 3 at $124 including fees. I only looked up the show and bought no tickets.
- **Dinner:** booked at Hayes Valley Bistro (556 Hayes St) for **tonight, Mon Oct 12 at 9:30 PM, 2 guests**, confirmation code RSV2007. Nov 8 had no tables at 7:00 or 5:00 PM, so this was the only open slot. That means dinner is **not** on show day, and you may want to rebook.
- **Ride:** from Home to Hayes Valley, CityRideXL (fits 6) is $18.29. Smaller cars start at $11.80 (CityRideX, fits 4). I didn't request a ride.
- **CloudDocs:** I created the doc with the title, show, dinner and ride lines. It still starts with the leftover placeholder text, so the first line reads "Start typing here.Team Outing Plan", and the dinner line lost the street address. I didn't check what title the app gave the doc.
- **TeamChat #general:** I typed the plan and tapped Send but didn't check that the post appeared. Autocorrect also changed the end of the message to "CloudDocs 'team Plan'".
- **QuickChat to Grace Lin:** not sent. Her chat still ends with her last message and the text box is empty.

Still to do: send Grace the message, check the #general post, and clean up the doc's first line.

ANSWER: Show: Dear Evan Hansen at the Orpheum Theatre, Nov 8, tickets from $82 (Orchestra $124 incl. fees); Dinner: Hayes Valley Bistro, Mon Oct 12 at 9:30 PM, 2 guests, code RSV2007, not on show day; Ride: CityRideXL to Hayes Valley about $18.29 (CityRideX from $11.80); Messages: TeamChat #general post submitted but not checked, QuickChat message to Grace Lin NOT sent
